title: busy-fleet-guard: Opus must delegate or top up the fleet
desc: Blocks Opus from running direct non-wk commands when no delegation was dispatched in the last 30 minutes. Forces fleet usage.
steps: SAFETY: Fires when Opus session runs a direct Bash/PowerShell/Edit command (non-wk-prefix, non-git, non-skill) and no delegation was dispatched in the last 30 minutes. Opus is expensive -- it must orchestrate, not execute.

SOLUTION: Dispatch work to cheap agents: 'Agent.cmd --model haiku <task>' or 'wkcodex.sh <task>'. This resets the fleet dispatch timestamp and allows subsequent direct commands. Kill switch: set WKHARNESS_BUSYFLEET=0 to disable for the session.

PREVENTION: As an Opus session, always delegate mechanical/execution work first. Run at least one Agent.cmd or wkcodex.sh dispatch before attempting direct file edits or shell commands. You orchestrate; agents execute.

requirements.expect: delegate or top up the fleet

author: claude
